summary: Goal Contract accepted for PHASE-001; no current HITL blocker.
evidence: Approved canonical baseline and decisions DEC-011 through DEC-018

goal_contract.objective: Establish reproducible checks and characterize useful WIP behavior, then remove Zendesk and fabricated execution contexts while preserving local mock journeys.
deliverables: D1: one npm workspace/lock, exact Node 24.20.0/npm 11.19.0 and validated Mastra pins, no functional Bun
D2: installed-version API and registry audit for all primitives and three candidate model IDs
D3: pre-removal synthetic deterministic characterization of schemas, ingest/dedup, workflow resolution/approval/rejection/escalation/failure, RAG/API
D4: all tools registered, specialists from registry, real runtime request/correlation/tracing/hooks preserved
D5: Zod boundaries, shared frontend contracts, verifiable OpenAPI/contract drift
D6: complete functional Zendesk removal with generic support abstraction preserved
D7: accurate npm quickstart/capability docs and separable commits
D8: complete check-only npm gates replacing every DEC-018 exception before independent review/PR
acceptance: Actual npm ci and frozen-install dry-run succeed
Installed APIs and current OpenAI IDs verified before behavioral refactor without substitution
Both scopes pass format/lint/strict typecheck/unit/integration, plus contracts, Playwright E2E, phase-scoped deterministic eval and both builds
Golden useful mock journeys preserved; legacy safety/durability deficiencies documented rather than accepted as finished
Registry identity and applicable context/correlation/tracing/hooks demonstrated
Invalid API payloads rejected; frontend/OpenAPI mismatch check fails on drift
No functional Zendesk/Bun or fabricated execution context
All full supervisor gates pass with no capability exceptions
Independent scope/diff/security review and findings policy pass
exclusions: PHASE-002 persistence, provider ports redesign, outbox/idempotency, money representation
PHASE-003 native financial agent approval, immutable commands, auth/RBAC/tenant/memory migration
failure_conditions: Version drift, failed install or unverifiable model ID
Mock regression, invalid boundary acceptance, contract drift
Unregistered primitives or missing real runtime propagation
P0/P1 unresolved or P2 without human deferral
hitl_triggers: Accepted requirements/material technology change or new production dependency
Destructive data change, unauthorized external mutation, cost increase
Material spec drift beyond DEC-018 gate replacement
